description.value: The Copper Room is the signature evening dining venue at Harrison Hot Springs Resort & Spa, situated on the shores of Harrison Lake beneath the Coastal Mountains. It offers a multi-format dinner menu (à la carte, table d'hôte, children's menu, and a drink menu) alongside nightly live music and an open dance floor, making it one of the more theatrical dining experiences in the Fraser Valley. A touring cyclist arriving here would find a polished, reservation-required dinner room inside a full-service resort rather than a casual stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Copper Room is an active dinner restaurant within Harrison Hot Springs Resort & Spa, featuring nightly live music and requiring reservations; this is clearly a real, operating venue. A reservation phone number (604.491.9246) appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags, so it is adopted as the phone value with contact_confirmed.phone set to null (no OSM value to compare against). No cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, takeout, Wi-Fi, or washrooms—are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or address; phone 604.491.9246 is sourced from the website only.
OSM community field is 'Chilliwack', but the coordinates and resort branding place this in Harrison Hot Springs village, which is a distinct municipality from Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating restaurant at an established resort, confirmed active by website content; no grounds for exclusion.
